title: Two major quest chains ('The True Pardon' at Thornwold, 'Hob's Marked Pick'/'Wenna's Name'/'The Hundred' at Cinderhall) name a destination ('the gallows glade', 'the Hundred Gallery') but give no directional guidance to find it; each is buried many rooms deep in an unmarked wilderness maze of 15-20+ near-identical tiles. I spent roughly 100 turns wandering for each before stumbling onto the correct thread by chance (a stray 'gallows road' exit label, a lucky westward detour).
where: Thornwold deep wood / Iron Downs spoil-heaps
